```{r}
#| label: biomarker-data-prep
#| include: false

tmp <- ucd_clean |> 
  dplyr::filter(fxs_sts_id %in% data$fxs_sts_id) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(fxs_sts_id) |>
  # fill in measurements only collected at baseline
  tidyr::fill(demo_age, .direction = "down") |>
  tidyr::fill(leit3_nv_iq, .direction = "down") |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = dplyr::if_else(
      Treatment == "Control", "Placebo", Treatment
    ) |> 
      factor(levels = c("Placebo", "Metformin")),
    dplyr::across(
      .cols = c(demo_age, leit3_nv_iq),
      ~ .x - mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      .names = "{col}_center"
    ),
    Site = "UCD",
    cgis_soi_fct = dplyr::case_when(
      (cgis_soi == "1 = Normal" | 
         cgis_soi == "2 = Borderline Ill") ~ "< 3 = Normal, Borderline Ill",
      .default = cgis_soi
    ) |>
      factor(
        levels = c(
          "< 3 = Normal, Borderline Ill",
          "3 = Mildly Ill", "4 = Moderately Ill", "5 = Markedly Ill",
          "6 = Severely Ill", "7 = Among the Most Extremely Ill Patients"
        )
      )
  ) |> 
  dplyr::select(
    fxs_sts_id, redcap_event_name, Treatment, Site,
    tassone_fmr1, tassone_cyfip1, tassone_mmp9, fmrp_rhmc, demo_age_center,
    leit3_nv_iq_center, sex, demo_age, leit3_nv_iq, Molecular.Category,
    Race, Ethnicity, weight_kg, cgis_soi_fct
  ) |> 
  # set mmp9 to missing for week 8 (only 1 observation)
  dplyr::mutate(
    tassone_mmp9 = dplyr::if_else(
      (fxs_sts_id == "101990-100" & 
        redcap_event_name ==  "Week 8 Visit (Visit 2)"),
      NA,
      tassone_mmp9
    )
  )

# log transform data use log(x + 0.5min(x))
fmr1_hm <- min(tmp[tmp$tassone_fmr1 > 0, ]$tassone_fmr1, na.rm = TRUE) / 2
cyfip_hm <- min(tmp[tmp$tassone_cyfip1 > 0, ]$tassone_cyfip1, na.rm = TRUE) / 2
mmp9_hm <- min(tmp[tmp$tassone_mmp9 > 0, ]$tassone_mmp9, na.rm = TRUE) / 2
fmrp_hm <- min(tmp[tmp$fmrp_rhmc > 0, ]$fmrp_rhmc, na.rm = TRUE) / 2

tmp <- tmp |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    tassone_fmr1_log = log(tassone_fmr1 + fmr1_hm),
    tassone_cyfip1_log = log(tassone_cyfip1 + cyfip_hm),
    tassone_mmp9_log = log(tassone_mmp9 + mmp9_hm),
    fmrp_rhmc_log = log(fmrp_rhmc + fmrp_hm),
    age_group = dplyr::case_when(
      demo_age < 12 ~ "Age 6-11",
      demo_age >= 12 ~ "Age 12+"
    ) |>
      factor(levels = c("Age 6-11", "Age 12+")
    )
  )

biomarker_data <- tmp
```
